name: Daily Lab Activity
query:
SELECT
    `tabLab Test`.department as "Department",
    `tabLab Test`.lab_test_name as "Laboratory Services", 
    COUNT(CASE WHEN `tabPatient Encounter`.branch = "Muthaiga" THEN 1 END) as "Muthaiga Clinic",
    COUNT(CASE WHEN `tabPatient Encounter`.branch = "Buruburu" THEN 1 END) as "Buruburu Clinic",
    COUNT(CASE WHEN `tabPatient Encounter`.branch = "Donholms" THEN 1 END) as "Donholms Clinic",
    COUNT(CASE WHEN `tabPatient Encounter`.branch = "Embakasi" THEN 1 END) as "Embakasi Clinic",
    COUNT(CASE WHEN `tabPatient Encounter`.branch = "Githogoro" THEN 1 END) as "Githogoro Clinic",  
    COUNT(CASE WHEN `tabPatient Encounter`.branch = "Junction" THEN 1 END) as "Junction Clinic",
    COUNT(CASE WHEN `tabPatient Encounter`.branch = "Kitengela" THEN 1 END) as "Kitengela Clinic",
    COUNT(CASE WHEN `tabPatient Encounter`.branch = "Komarock" THEN 1 END) as "Komarock Clinic",
    COUNT(CASE WHEN `tabPatient Encounter`.branch = "Lavington" THEN 1 END) as "Lavington Clinic",
    COUNT(CASE WHEN `tabPatient Encounter`.branch = "Mombasa" THEN 1 END) as "Mombasa Clinic", 
    COUNT(CASE WHEN `tabPatient Encounter`.branch = "Nairobi West" THEN 1 END) as "Nairobi West Clinic",
    COUNT(CASE WHEN `tabPatient Encounter`.branch = "Pangani" THEN 1 END) as "Pangani Clinic",
    COUNT(CASE WHEN `tabPatient Encounter`.branch = "Rongai" THEN 1 END) as "Rongai Clinic",
    COUNT(CASE WHEN `tabPatient Encounter`.branch = "Syokimau" THEN 1 END) as "Syokimau Clinic",
    COUNT(CASE WHEN `tabPatient Encounter`.branch = "Thika" THEN 1 END) as "Thika Clinic",
    COUNT(CASE WHEN `tabPatient Encounter`.branch = "TRM" THEN 1 END) as "TRM Clinic",
    COUNT(CASE WHEN `tabPatient Encounter`.branch = "Westlands" THEN 1 END) as "Westlands Clinic", 
    COUNT(`tabPatient Encounter`.branch) as "Clinic Totals"
FROM 
    `tabPatient Encounter`  
    
LEFT JOIN 
    `tabLab Test` ON `tabPatient Encounter`.patient = `tabLab Test`.patient
    
WHERE 
    DATE_FORMAT(`tabPatient Encounter`.encounter_date, '%%Y-%%m-%%d') BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s
GROUP BY `tabLab Test`.lab_test_name
